---
name: frontend-feature
description: Use when implementing marketplace routes, components, forms, data fetching, responsive behavior, accessibility, or UI states.
---

Read the feature spec, API contract, frontend rules, and relevant ADRs. Design success, loading, empty, error, disabled, and responsive states. Keep authorization server-side, validate at boundaries, use accessible semantics, and test user behavior rather than implementation details.

Quality check: keyboard use, small screens, failed requests, and empty data are considered.
